Following each Track session, each Driver is permitted to request a judicial investigation into an alleged on-track incident by completing a Request for Investigation (RFI) form and lodging the form with the DRD within thirty (30) minutes of the completion of the relevant Track session.

If in the opinion of the DSA and/or the RD , an RFI is warranted (irrespective of whether the investigation results in a prosecution), the RFI will not count towards the Drivers RFI tally.

If in the opinion of the DSA and/or the RD , an RFI is unwarranted or frivolous, the RFI will count towards the Drivers RFI tally.

Once a Driver lodges three (3) unwarranted RFI forms, that Driver will be prohibited from lodging any further RFI forms for the remainder of the Championship .

An incomplete RFI form will not be investigated and will be considered to be an unwarranted form.

A Competitor and/or Team member is not permitted to lodge an RFI form.

To be eligible to enter and compete in the Championship , each Driver is required to be registered with the CM .

A Driver can apply to register to compete in the Championship as either a Championship Registered Driver or a Casually Registered Driver .

A Driver will only be considered as being registered to compete in the Championship as a Championship Registered Driver following:

Lodgment of a completed Registration Application Form and associated Commercial Agreement;

Receipt of written confirmation from PCA that their application has been unconditionally accepted;

Payment of the applicable Registration Fee as detailed in the Commercial Agreement; and

Receipt of written notification from the CM that they are registered.

A maximum of twenty-eight (28) Championship Registered Drivers will be accepted for the Championship by the CM in its sole and absolute discretion without providing any reasons.

The CM reserves the right to accept or refuse a Registration Application Form from any Driver in its sole and absolute discretion without providing any reasons.
